item.description:
The first Mac release of Pendenz as a download.
Open the DMG and drag Pendenz into Applications. The app is signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so it opens without a warning. It needs macOS 27 and a Pendenz server to pair with; see the [quickstart](https://github.com/unveroleone/pendenz#get-started) to run one.
From now on the app updates itself. On its second launch it asks whether it may check for new versions on its own, which it then does once a day. **Pendenz > Check for Updates…** checks right away.
